steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: How're you holdin' up, dai lo? Is your wound still hurting? Hang in there, I'll get you to the hospital right away.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: *inhales sharply*... No, Ah Jun. We can't go to there. We'll be found out...

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: You idiot, we'd be walkin' straight into quicksand if we go to the hospital. The docs over there are sharp. They'll know something's up the moment they see a wound like this.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: B-But... Yu, we can't just leave him like this, can we?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I heard there's a small clinic up at the front of this alley. Wanna head there and try your luck?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: There won't be as many doctors in a small-time place like that, so it'll be easy to keep things under control. Why don't we...?

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Sure... Let's go. I think it'll be fine.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Hang in there, dai lo. We'll get you there.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Windows... Locked. Curtains... Can't leave a single gap.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Stuff under the beds... Lemme see...

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Good. Everything's there.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: And what else... Ah, of course, gotta lock up the door.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Good thing I remembered. Nearly forgot there...

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Who is it––?)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Don't think I've seen their mugs before...)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Nei hou. Who might you be?
Is there a doctor in the house? My brother here... He's hurt. Can you save him?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: We're closed for the day. Could I ask you to come back tomorrow?
Doc, you... How could you just turn down a guy on death's door like that?!

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: If it's really that serious, why not go to a proper hospital for treatment instead of knockin' on the door of my shack off the corner of the street in the middle of the night?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: The more you argue with me, the more it proves your bro over there is far from death's door.
The hell? What kind of doctor are you anyway to be talking like that?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Huh, that's funny. I never said anything about being a doctor.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Give it up. You can't kick this door down.
Sei puk gaai...

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Did they leave...?)
The anxious doctor holds his breath and stretches his neck to look out the door's mirror, seeing no one standing under the eaves.

Just to be sure, however, he puts his ear close to the door's panel. After a while, when he is sure that no sounds are coming from the other side of the door, he steadies his nerves and clutches his chest as he finally lets out a deep exhale.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (That scared me half to death, I thought one of the old man's enemies came to settle the score.)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Never expected someone to show up looking for a doctor at this hour though. Weird... Don't tell me that old timer I saved a few days ago is talking up my medical skills again.)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: What a pain... Should've left this place to rot a long time ago. All I wanted was to put some food on the table, and maybe fix a few sniffles and head colds in the process.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Ugh... But, I let curiosity get the better of me when I saw that old timer's condition.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: This place shouldn't last much longer. The old man pissed off so many people, it won't be long until someone comes bangin' on the door after they hear the news.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Crap... I gotta get outta here.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Ugh, what awful luck. Barely got half a year of normalcy... When am I gonna be able to stop running and hiding?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Huh–?!

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Shit... I forgot to latch the back door...)

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Heheh. Sir, your rear entrance isn't as secure as the front door. All it took was a few bits of metal wire.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Hmm... Sounds like your brother's injury must be pretty serious. Can't wait a moment, can you?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: You little shit. If you know what's good for you, you'll shut your trap and fix him up. Anything happens to him, you're a dead man.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: C'mon, buddy... If you help me out this time, I promise, I'll return the favor. You won't regret it.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: The two of you are singin' very two different tunes, but I like the sound of it.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: You're overthinking it, man.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Heh. And what tune will you be singing?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Whatever you want to hear. There's no shame in that.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Smooth talker, aren't we–

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Gah! You bastard!

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Hey, what the hell are you doing? Hands off, don't hurt me!

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Quit your yapping, buddy. Just behave yourself, and, *cough* *cough*... think carefully about how you're gonna fix me up.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Urgh... Hiss...

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Are you even taking this seriously, you little shit?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Can't you tell I'm stitching up a wound?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Enough of that, Yu. By the way, sir, would you happen to have any anesthetics?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: You think a little hut like mine would have stuff like that? Don't come here if you're afraid of a little pain.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: My medicine bottle!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Mind your tone, if you care about whatever's left of this stuff.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Calm down, calm down. One of these bastards' arms is as thick as both my legs...)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Alright. I'm gonna chat with your brother here to distract him from the pain, alright?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Hey, can you still talk?

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Run that mouth, if you want. Just don't stop working.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: So, how'd you get that injury along your back? Looks like your skin and muscle literally got ripped apart. Almost twenty centimeters from your shoulders to the back of your waist after I measured it.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Got caught on the spikes of an iron fence.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Were you hopping a wall?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Excuse me, but did my words offend you in some way?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Mind your own business. There are some questions you shouldn't ask.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Patience, patience. I don't have any drugs on hand capable of dealing with these guys...)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Say... How did you find this place?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Someone told us there's a small clinic here. Said he's been here before.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: So, you're really just here to get an injury treated?

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Why else?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Nobody said anything about me, right? Anything like... about some of the 'patients' I saw before?

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Nothing I care about.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Looks like they're just a bunch of nobodies... I've been overreacting here.)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: You're a hard one to talk to, huh? Forget it, I'll just put the radio on; maybe it'll make a better conversation partner.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Gah, if you aren't some Triad here looking for revenge, I guess you're the unlucky one for falling into my hands.)

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: This is a breaking news report. At 6:00 PM today, the Lungmen Jewelry Co. was viciously robbed.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: Three gangsters armed with short crossbows subdued the clerk, pried open the counter, and fled with jewelry valued in the tens of millions.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: Authorities reported that following the robbery, the L.G.D. rushed to the scene of the crime and confirmed that the shop assistant was in critical condition after trying to fight off the criminals, and is currently in intensive care.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: According to the clerk's statements, the three criminals were all wearing masks, and one of them sustained an injury to his back, which should've left a wound.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: We hope that people from all walks of life will proactively provide information about these at-large suspects...

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Shut up already, dumb machine.
The man sitting at the table rudely presses the power button before the announcement can finish.
The doctor stiffly turns his head and sees a look of displeasure on the man's face, his hands in his pockets as if brandishing something.
When he lowers his head again and looks at the bloody back of the man lying on the bed, the doctor sucks in a mouthful of cold air.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Well, shit...)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: This isn't good.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: What isn't good?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (*gulp*)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Uhh... What else would it be? His wound, umm... I don't have enough medicine here. All I can do is some suture work, but I can't say how well he'll recover later.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Hey, man, what the hell are you standing up for?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: I just want to make a quick call to have someone bring over some more medicine. What are you getting all tense for?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Making a call? No, we can't have you doing that.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Looks like I'm right on the money here, given how paranoid they are. What do I do now then...?)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (If I'm not careful... They're gonna shut me up forever to keep the evidence from leaking out.)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Or maybe... No, I can't. I can't reveal my identity. Not now, after I'm so close to finally breaking from the old ways and settling down.)

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: (*sticks a hand into his pocket and strokes something*)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Shit, he's reaching into his pocket again... Is it a knife? Or a mini crossbow?)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Calm down, there has to be some way...)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (I got it!)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Wait, no, if I do that... my identity's gonna get blown.)

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Hey, what are you doing over there, all quiet?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: I'm... thinking hard about how to get the meds your brother needs since you won't let me place a call.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Your brother's lying there and he's not getting better without drugs. You're not just gonna wait around and let him die, are you?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Ugh... I can't think too far down the road. I need to make it out of this alive first.)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: How about this? One of you can go to buy the medicine while the other one stays here. Don't worry, with a twiggy body like mine, what's the worst I could do to your dai lo?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Hmm... What do you say, Yu?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Ah Jun, go get the meds. I'll keep an eye on this kid.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: What if he pulls something?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: What are you worrying for? You think this kid's gonna be able to pull any funny business with me around?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Diu... This pharmacy's out in the middle of nowhere. You're really not making this easy for me, aren't you?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Excuse me, anybody home?

steps.name: Pharmacy Owner
steps.text: Coming, coming. Give me a second, I'll be right out.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I have a prescription here. do you have all the meds on THIS sheet?

steps.name: Pharmacy Owner
steps.text: I do, but...

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: But what? If you have 'em, just bring 'em out. My brother needs 'em badly.

steps.name: Pharmacy Owner
steps.text: Your brother... is going to use them? If you don't mind me asking, friend, what kind of work does your brother do?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Look, if you know what's good for you, you'll stop prying into our business. His work isn't something for people like you to ask about.

steps.name: Pharmacy Owner
steps.text: Right, right... The stuff you wanted is, ah yes... I'll have the clerk bring everything out shortly.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Hurry it up!

steps.name: Pharmacy Owner
steps.text: Miss An, please. Pull the medicines here as they appear on the sheet. Don't get anything mixed up.

steps.name: Pharmacy Owner
steps.text: (Also, I need to make a phone call to that gentleman... The man's not dead. He's back.)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Hey, could you stop pacing back and forth? It's making me dizzy.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Hmph. If he doesn't come back, you're gonna have hell to pay.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Don't worry. I sent him to a well-hidden pharmacy. Nobody's gonna know.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Looking at the time, he should be back any minute now...

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: See, there he is.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Ah Jun, did you get the stuff?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Yeah. How's the dai lo?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Not dead yet. Just waiting for you to bring the meds.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Here's the stuff you wanted.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Excellent. Everything here's good stuff.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Yu, we need to grab the dai lo and get out of here ASAP. While you were on the way back, I heard L.G.D. sirens in the distance. Looks like they've already started searching this neighborhood.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Wait a little. Let's leave after we grab the meds.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Hey, what the hell are you doing, you little shit? What are you making a ruckus for?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Have your bro take this wound-dressing medicine three times a day. Then, there's this dose of tonic. Have him take it every day before going to bed. The wound should be fully healed in a couple weeks.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Also, this is the savings I've accumulated over the past six months. Take it.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: What are you doing, man...?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Spending money to buy some peace of mind. You don't want to talk about where you came from, so you must not want anyone asking about where you're going either. I can only do the sensible thing and send you off respectfully.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: All I ask is that you spare my life, and if fate happens to bring us together again in the future, you can come to me if you ever get a headache.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: (*sticks his hand in hand in his pocket again and brandishes something*)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (Is he still not satisfied? I've already coughed up everything I can.)

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: How about this, then? I'll lure away the L.G.D. so the three of you can get away safely.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Your dai lo can put on my clothes, and I'll put on his bloody outfit. The two of you swap too.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: I'll head out the front to attract the L.G.D.'s attention, then you guys can slip out through the back. How about it?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: (Why's this little shit being so cooperative all of a sudden? He was so difficult earlier.)

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: (Who wouldn't wise up after getting a taste of your fists?)

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: (Good point. Now that the kid knows his place, we know where to come whenever we're short on money.)

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Ahaha, I never thought you'd to be such a loyal little buddy! We appreciate the favor!

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Ah Jun, Yu, make sure to express your gratitude to the gentleman here.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Hah. Didn't think the kid was actually telling the truth, but he really went to lure the L.G.D. away from us.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Uhh... Where are we?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Once we get out of this alley, we'll be on the Rat King's turf. The L.G.D. isn't gonna set foot there, so we can lay low for a while.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Did you hide all the money?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Yup. Buried it all under the pine tree in the yard. When things calm down later, we can go dig it out. It's enough to... Well, dunno how much exactly, but we'll never have to worry about money again for the rest of our lives.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: When it's time to dig up our loot, if your injury's healed by then, we'll head out to the gambling den and play to our hearts' content.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Wait, hold on...

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Who the hell are you people?

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Grab them. Don't let them get away.

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Hey, you. Get your hand out of your pocket.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: What's in your pocket? Show me!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: What are you fidgeting with then?

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Talk, now!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Th-There's a loose thread in my pocket, and I was just trying to pluck it out...

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: You gentlemen look like Triads... I'm not sure what we did to provoke you.

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Are you the one who sent him to buy meds from Shum's?

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Yes, I got hurt and urgently needed medicine, so I sent my younger brother.

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Well, would you look at that. So you're the poison-dealing rogue doctor. You've been hiding for over half a year, but we've finally found you.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Get your hands off him!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Aaaargh!

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Making this hard on yourself, huh...? Beat the shit out of him.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Stop, stop! Look, Yu's the one who protects the dai lo, and he got hurt, so he's kind of out of it.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: We don't know anything about this rogue doctor, but I'm sure this is all some sort of misunderstanding.

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Hmph. Save it for our dai lo and see if he cares to hear you out. Take them away.

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Dai lo, dai lo! Are you alright?!

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Urgh, where are you dragging us off to?

steps.name: Triad
steps.text: Grab that guy and take him too.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Let go of me! I can walk by myself!

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Haha, looks like it was one big misunderstanding.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Kid, you showed up in the middle of the street in those bloody rags. How could our officers not be suspicious?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Understandable, understandable.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Alright, this is as far as we can take you. Hurry on home now.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Uhh, I'm afraid I can't go back at the moment.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Haha, don't you worry. We've already taken the robbers into custody.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Already? Didn't I just tip you off?

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: We tracked them from an underground pawn shop not long after the robbery and located them not long after.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: A pawn shop? If they went to a pawn shop, the guys who showed up at my place yesterday were...

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Probably just some petty thieves. Someone filed a police report that someone broke into their home, and I guess there were bloodstains on the railings.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Oh, I thought...

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: (They didn't lie to me after all. That guy really did get hurt hopping a fence.)

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Thought what?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Too bad...

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: What do you mean by that, young man?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Officer... There's something I was trying to do, but it didn't work out in the end.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: I see. Well, young folks like you have plenty of opportunities to get back on your feet. Doesn't matter if you get knocked down a few times.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: How will you know what you really want if you don't go out there and try?

steps.name: Rogue Doctor
steps.text: The two of us are too alike. It's both a blessing and a curse.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Old man, if you've got extra time on your hands, go pop some pills for your dementia. Who the hell have you been messin' with lately? Because of you, I got chased up and down the streets for no reason.

steps.name: Rogue Doctor
steps.text: Hah. And you made it out in one piece thanks to the ol' tricks I taught you, huh?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: What, so I owe you my thanks or something? I must've had some great karma to land an old piece of shit like you for a dad.

steps.name: Rogue Doctor
steps.text: Heh, the honor is mine.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: So, you really can't keep your head down even for a few days so I can enjoy a peaceful ones?

steps.name: Rogue Doctor
steps.text: Give it up already. You know that life ain't for you.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Guess so. Even if you kick the bucket, your enemies wouldn't give me a moment of peace 'til the day I follow after you.

steps.name: Rogue Doctor
steps.text: Ah Zai, even if you didn't have guys coming after you, you wouldn't get to live a life like that.

steps.name: Rogue Doctor
steps.text: I told you, the two of us are too alike. We've got the very same restlessness in our bones.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: What a load of shit. I'm nothing like you.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: ...Officer.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Wh-What are you staring at me for, all of a sudden?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: It's a darned shame there are so few paths available for me. If this path is blocked, I can only go back to the one I was on before.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: It's not an easy path to walk, but... it's not all bad either. At least, it'll keep me entertained.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Things are a tad too boring these days.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Anyway, I won't bother you anymore. You seem like a good person, so hopefully our paths never cross again.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: What's with that kid, talking all lofty and philosophical all of a sudden? People these days don't make any sense.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Well, whatever. Still got a lot of work to do though, so I should hurry on back for now.
Wait a second, Officer Chang.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Lee, you're here too?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Long time no see. I heard you were blessed with a lovely daughter recently?

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Hahaha, no news escapes your ears, Mr. Lee. An absolute chonker of a girl, six catties. Worked my wife half to death.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh my. You'd best hurry to the jewelry store and pick up a pair of gold bracelets to properly show your appreciation for her.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Way ahead of you. Got it right here in my pocket.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I suppose the two of us won't be able to go drinking anytime soon then.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Please. As if I could ever turn down an invitation from you, sir.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're a slick talker; I like that. I'll have to have a good chat with your boss.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: I'm afraid you came here for nothing then. The old fellow's tied up with a conference right now and still hasn't come out.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Did something big happen?

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: You haven't heard?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: About what?

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Uh... I suppose telling you won't do any harm.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: Apparently, that rogue doctor who caused all sorts of trouble in the city is back.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Didn't you say he was dead?

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: That's right. But we just got a report today that someone went to the pharmacist he used to frequent and grabbed some medicinal herbs.

steps.name: L.G.D. Supervisor
steps.text: There's nothing particularly unusual about those herbs by themselves, but when they're used together in a formula... there's only one man who could've prescribed it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: ...I see. Sounds like things are going to get lively around here again.
